aPropos.p1: Gest-224 was born from a simple observation: running the commercial side of a small business — quotes, invoices, purchase and delivery orders, basic accounting — still often relies on makeshift spreadsheets or tools built for large organizations, too heavy for a freelancer or a very small business.
aPropos.p2: We're building a platform that handles the full document chain — from quote to invoice, through purchase order, delivery note, deposit invoice and credit note — following French and European invoicing rules: gapless sequential numbering, mandatory legal notices, VAT exemption handling (art. 293 B of the French tax code), late-payment penalties.
aPropos.p3: On top of that, simplified accounting: income is generated automatically when an invoice is marked as paid, expenses are entered in a few clicks, and a dashboard gives a clear view of the balance and monthly activity — without turning the user into an accountant.
aPropos.p4: Gest-224 is still a young product, continuously developed and improved. Structured e-invoicing (Factur-X, PDP) is on our roadmap, in anticipation of upcoming French regulatory deadlines.
